items.html: And indeed the phase of the existence of the vessel began only in the world of Akudim, but only one vessel was formed for all ten of its Sefirot. And afterward, in the world of Nekudim, before they broke, some correction was added in them, namely, that ten vessels were formed for the ten Sefirot within it. There was also a second correction: that GAR came out and were corrected by way of lines, which was not so with ZAT, which came out one on top of the other and were not connected. And afterward, when the Nekudim broke, another correction was added in them, namely, that the lights of ZAT too clothed by way of the lines of KHB, as was said above.
